tagline: The only capital with a safari inside it — lions and giraffes graze at the city's edge, ten minutes from markets, matatu art and nyama choma.
overview: Nairobi is the only capital on earth with a full national park inside its boundaries — Nairobi National Park's lions, rhinos and giraffes roam against a backdrop of skyscrapers, and the giraffe centre at Karen adds a gentler encounter.

The city grew from a swampy railway camp ('cool water' in Maasai) into East Africa's economic engine — and its energy is in the streets: the open-air Maasai Market, the art-covered matatu minibuses, and the smoke of nyama choma (roast meat) joints at night.

Speed's 2025 Africa tour streamed from Nairobi to wild crowds. For travellers it's the gateway — the park at dawn, orphaned elephants at the Sheldrick sanctuary at noon, dinner in the city by night, then out to the Mara or Amboseli.

funFacts.title: A SAFARI IN THE CITY
funFacts.text: Nairobi National Park's lions and giraffes graze 7km from downtown — skyline visible behind the zebras.

funFacts.title: THE RAILWAY SWAMP
funFacts.text: The city began as an 1899 rail depot on Maasai land — 'Enkare Nairobi' means cool water.

funFacts.title: THE BABY ELEPHANTS
funFacts.text: The Sheldrick Wildlife Trust rears orphaned elephants — visitors watch the mud-bath feedings.

funFacts.title: FEED A GIRAFFE
funFacts.text: The Giraffe Centre lets you hand-feed Rothschild giraffes — next door to the famous manor.

funFacts.title: MATATU CULTURE
funFacts.text: Nairobi's minibus taxis are rolling art galleries with DJ sound systems.

funFacts.title: THE GREEN LUNG
funFacts.text: Karura Forest's waterfalls and trails sit inside the city — saved from developers by Wangari Maathai.

funFacts.title: KAREN BLIXEN'S FARM
funFacts.text: The Out of Africa author's house is a museum in the suburb named for her.

funFacts.title: SILICON SAVANNAH
funFacts.text: Mobile money (M-Pesa) was invented here — Nairobi leads East African tech.

funFacts.title: NYAMA CHOMA NIGHTS
funFacts.text: Roast goat or beef with ugali is the national night out.

funFacts.title: A MILE-HIGH CITY
funFacts.text: At ~1,795m the climate stays springlike year-round on the equator.
